notes.title: 1.1.5 - bugfixes + full game footage
notes.notes:
Hi all,

We've just published version 1.1.5 of the Prologue. This contains a few fixes:

 Fixed bug not being able to delete saves
 Fixed bug not being able to store framerate
 No more internet connectivity required for features such as the cavern of names and the shrine
 Various other small fixes to performance, stability and design


Full game footage
We also have something else for you: a video showcase of the Arena in the full game! Know that what you're seeing is still subject to change, incomplete and not bug free. The arena will be a side activity in the full game, but it's very important to us early on to finetune combat mechanics.

[previewyoutube=QkOVCbgv0rI;full][/previewyoutube]

That's it for now. We hope you've enjoyed it, please don't forget to wishlist the full game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/980700/Unsung_Warriors/

Cheers,
Mikel & Ramon

notes.title: 1.1.1 - Kickstarter launch update
notes.notes:
Hi all,

We've released a small update which ties in with our just launched Kickstarter campaign. More about that below.

New in this version: because we want players to keep on exploring, we've added a new secret room, the location of which was conceived at our Discord. It's very hard to find, so to add a small hint: it's only reachable in two player mode (also when one player controls both characters). You can read here in which part of the dungeon the area can be found: [spoiler]in the water section, though not in the water itself[/spoiler]. For more hints, check out the secrets channel on our Discord.

Today we've also launched a new Kickstarter campaign for Unsung Warriors. A successful Kickstarter campaign will allow us to speed up development towards an Early Access release. We'll have several rewards, and all reward tiers include having your name engraved in the Cavern of Names.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34104140/5f7714da438cdd372f64b3435373ed3fa1a28dda.gif

Like what you see? Consider supporting our Kickstarter campaign or help spread the word!

Cheers,
Mikel & Ramon
